theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_exists_orthonormal_frame_eval_neg
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ v → ∃ w : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ w ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w) = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) ∧ ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), β w = -β v
